summary: The text argues against reducing E-Rate funding or adding screen-time requirements, emphasizing the importance of reliable internet access for education and student success. It cites Alabama's experience with technology access and academic recovery as evidence that reduced access does not necessarily improve outcomes.

claims.argument: Now is not the time to reduce ERate funding
claims.evidence_quote: Now is not the time to reduce ERate funding or to add new screen-time requirements for ERate program eligibility.
